method.imageEnumeration: find by image extension over the library, excluding raag/, raag-shoot-pro/, blushlounge/, influencers/ (2380 files); dimensions + 64-bit dHash via PIL for every file; sha256 only on the shortlisted files
method.captions: IMAGE_CATALOG.csv vision-pass descriptions (the README-designated live semantic register) where a row exists, else folder/file name only; treatment names taken from the ktahv-shoot-2025 file names; nothing invented; clinical-register scrub applied (guest→patient etc.); uncertain items carry [TO CONFIRM]
method.alreadyOnSite: true when sha256 matches a served file under public/ahv/assets/img/**, OR the normalised filename stem matches, OR a served image is visually near-identical (dHash distance <= 4); distance 5–6 is surfaced in siteMatch but does not set the flag
method.libraryDedup: within each gallery pool, files with dHash distance <= 3 are collapsed to one keeper (prefers the “-2” natural grade the catalog recommends, then the larger file); the rest are listed under rejected
method.ordering: score = catalog quality + register_ok + resolution + hero/gallery best_use − already-on-site − [TO CONFIRM]; then round-robin across subject keys so one treatment series does not dominate; capped at 80 per gallery, overflow kept in reserve
